### Added
- `gitops.forbidInlineSecrets` (default `false`): with `true` the meta-package render fails when a credential is set inline in the values — `kagent.providers.<name>.apiKey`, `kagent.oauth2-proxy.config.clientSecret` / `.cookieSecret`, `muster.muster.oauth.server.dex.clientSecret` / `.google.clientSecret` / `.registrationToken` / `.encryptionKeyValue` / `.storage.valkey.password`, `valkey.valkey.auth.aclUsers.<user>.password`, `klausGateway.slack.botToken` / `.signingSecret` / `.appToken`, `klausGateway.obo.stateKey` / `.storeKey`, `model-manager.oauth.dex.clientSecret`, `agent-manager.oauth.dex.clientSecret` — and names the offending key paths (never their values). Such a value is forwarded verbatim into the component's HelmRelease `spec.values` (Argo: `valuesObject`) and into Helm's release storage, readable by anyone allowed to get HelmReleases in `gitops.namespace`; every component chart takes the same credential from a pre-created Secret instead (kagent `providers.<name>.apiKeySecretRef` with an empty `apiKey` and `oauth2-proxy.config.existingSecret`, muster `oauth.server.existingSecret` and `.storage.valkey.existingSecret`, valkey `auth.usersExistingSecret`, klaus-gateway `slack.secretName` with an empty `botToken` and `obo.existingSecret` (klaus-gateway >= 0.39.0), model-manager / agent-manager `oauth.existingSecret`). The values.yaml guidance for those keys now recommends the pre-created Secret, and `klausGateway.obo.existingSecret` is documented next to the keys it replaces. `make verify-secrets` (in CI) pins the default, the failure and the referenced-Secret render. **No installation needs to act**: the flag is off and the default render is unchanged; an installation that has moved its credentials into Secrets sets it to `true` so they cannot come back.
